customer: Hi, sorry if this is a weird question, I just got off a twelve-hour night shift and I'm a bit foggy. I traded in my midsize SUV with you last week here in Virginia and you're paying off the loan on it, but my next payment is due soon and I honestly don't know if I'm supposed to still pay it or just let it go now that the car's gone. I really don't want to mess up my credit over this, so what should I do?
agent: No worries at all, and thanks for checking before the due date! Please keep making your regular loan payments until your lender confirms the loan is paid off, because a missed payment in the meantime can be reported as late on your credit history. Our payoff covers the amount your lender quoted, and if one of your payments goes through after the payoff, your lender will refund it to you. You can find more on that in our article "Getting back an extra loan payment."
